description: öV-Güteklasse is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Solothurn. Die öV-Güteklassen sind ein Instrument zur Beschreibung der Qualität der öV-Erschliessung. Die öV-Güteklasse eines Standorts ergibt sich aus der Entfernung zu einem öV-Haltepunkt und dem Angebot (Taktdichte) an dieser Haltestelle. Die Berechnung erfolgt auf Grundlage der (mittlerweile nicht mehr gültigen) VSS-Norm SN 640 290. Coverage: Kanton Solothurn. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Solothurn. It offers 5 resource(s) in GPKG, HTML, OCTET, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
